description: Look up and risk-score up to 25 phone numbers in one call (the CallerKit API itself has no bulk endpoint; this runs single lookups with limited concurrency). Returns a compact row per number (name, spam count, risk level/score). Duplicates are removed and invalid numbers are reported separately. Costs 1 credit per number with a name on record, so confirm with the user before running large lists. For deeper detail on one number call callerkit_lookup_phone.

country.description: Default ISO country for any national-format numbers in the list.

name: callerkit_bulk_lookup
title: Look up several phone numbers
